name: BITE
base_effect: Melee attack requiring a target appendage to clamp onto; you taste the victim's blood.

upgrades.5: +1d8 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d8 base damage. You may latch on to move when the foe moves during their next Action (then you let go).
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage, and the target gains the Woozy Debuff.

name: BACK CLAW
base_effect: Melee animal/pet strike attack with no additional base effect stated.

upgrades.5: +1d6 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d6 base damage
upgrades.15: +1d6 base damage, and the target gains the Blood Trail Debuff.

name: SLICE ATTACK
base_effect: Melee animal/pet strike attack. AI Favor: 1.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage
upgrades.15: +2d4 base damage

name: CLUB
base_effect: Melee bashing weapon attack with no additional base effect stated.

upgrades.5: +1d6 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d6 base damage, and the target gains the Woozy Debuff.
upgrades.15: +1d6 base damage, and if the target loses at least 3 Health Bar slots, they gain the Take Down Debuff.

name: IMPROVISED WEAPONS
base_effect: Pick up an object weighing at least 1 pound and no more than your Str in pounds and smack someone with it. AI Favor: 1.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage, and you can throw the item (using this Skill) up to a range of Rank x 5 feet.
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage, and you roll your first Attack each combat with Advantage.
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage

name: WARHAMMER
base_effect: Melee bashing weapon attack. Requires two hands to wield.

upgrades.5: +1d10 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d10 base damage
upgrades.15: +1d10 base damage, and the target (of your size or smaller) is pushed 15 feet.

name: AXE
base_effect: Melee edged weapon attack with no additional base effect stated.

upgrades.5: +1d6 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d6 base damage, and you may make an extra free Attack with Disadvantage against another foe adjacent to both you and the original target.
upgrades.15: +1d6 base damage, and on an Amazing Success or better, sever an arm (or similar) of your foe, disarming anyone with a two-handed weapon.

name: DAGGER
base_effect: Melee edged weapon attack. AI Favor: 1.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage, and this Attack deals Armor-Piercing damage (ignores DR).
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage, and you can throw this weapon (using this Skill) up to a range of Rank x 5 feet.
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage, and Attacks targeting the back of a foe deal x2 damage.

name: LONGSWORD
base_effect: Melee edged weapon attack with no additional base effect stated.

upgrades.5: +1d8 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d8 base damage
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage, and you gain a +1 Evade Buff.

name: RAPIER
base_effect: Melee edged weapon attack with no additional base effect stated.

upgrades.5: +1d6 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d6 base damage, and you gain a +1 Evade Buff.
upgrades.15: +1d6 base damage, and you gain a +1 Evade Buff.

name: FOOT SOLDIER
base_effect: Hand-to-hand attack; choose the Powerful Strike or Smush Damage Effect (if you wish) before rolling to hit. AI Favor: 1 only if no Damage Effect is used.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage, and the target gains the Sore as Shit Debuff.

name: NOGGIN NOCKER
base_effect: Headbutt-like hand-to-hand attack; on Success you lose 1 Health Bar slot. Choose the Skullcracker or Powerful Strike Damage Effect (if you wish) before rolling. AI Favor: 1 only if no Damage Effect is used.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage, and you don't take any damage from your own Attack.
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage, and add 1 Rank damage die.
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage, and the target gains the Woozy Debuff.

name: PUGILISM
base_effect: Punching hand-to-hand attack; choose the Dirty Fighting, Iron Punch, or Powerful Strike Damage Effect (if you wish) before rolling. AI Favor: 2 only if no Damage Effect is used.

upgrades.5: +2d2 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d2 base damage
upgrades.15: +1d2 base damage, and you may make an extra free Attack with Disadvantage.

name: UNARMED COMBAT
base_effect: Every crawler starts with this mixed-strikes hand-to-hand attack. Cannot choose a Damage Effect. AI Favor: 1.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage
upgrades.15: +2d4 base damage

name: WRASSLIN'
base_effect: Grappling hand-to-hand attack requiring two hands; choose the Choke Out, Dirty Fighting, or Toss Damage Effect (if you wish) before rolling. On Success the target gains the Held Debuff until they spend an Action to attempt escape; you must use an Action as an Interrupt and succeed in a Wrasslin' Str-Opposed Skill Check to prevent escape. AI Favor: 1 only if no Damage Effect is used.

upgrades.5: You may maintain the Held Debuff at no Action cost if you wish, but your Skill Check to prevent escape is made with Disadvantage.
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage

name: CHOKE OUT
base_effect: Wrasslin' Damage Effect, Passive. If the target is at 10% Health Bar or less, you deal x2 the total damage.

upgrades.5: Choke Out activates at 20% Health Bar or less.
upgrades.10: Choke Out activates at 40% Health Bar or less, and deals x4 the total damage.
upgrades.15: Choke Out activates at 80% Health Bar or less, and deals x8 the total damage.

name: DIRTY FIGHTING
base_effect: Pugilism or Wrasslin' Damage Effect, Passive. Uses underhanded tactics; if the Attack Skill Check is a Critical Fail, lose 1 Popularity. Applies the Woozy Debuff to the target.

upgrades.5: Also apply The Taint Debuff to the target.
upgrades.10: Also apply the Blinded Debuff to the target. You no longer lose Popularity on Critical Fails.
upgrades.15: Also apply an immediate Minor Injury Debuff to the target.

name: IRON PUNCH
base_effect: Pugilism Damage Effect, Passive. You deal +1d2 base damage.

upgrades.5: Add 1 Rank damage die.
upgrades.10: You may choose to have the target gain the Stunned Debuff instead of rolling damage.
upgrades.15: Add 1 Rank damage die, and the target gains the Stunned Debuff.

name: POWERFUL STRIKE
base_effect: Foot Soldier, Noggin Nocker, or Pugilism Damage Effect, Passive. Cooldown: 30 hours. Multiply your base damage dice result by your Rank in this Skill, then add your modifiers and buffs.

upgrades.5: The cooldown is 10 hours.
upgrades.10: The cooldown is 5 hours.
upgrades.15: The cooldown is 2 hours.

name: SKULLCRACKER
base_effect: Noggin Nocker Damage Effect, Passive. If the target is the same size as you, gain +1d4 base damage.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage if target is the same size as you.
upgrades.10: If the target is the same size as you, add 1 Rank damage die, and the target gains the Stunned Debuff.
upgrades.15: If the target is the same size as you, add 1 Rank damage die, and the target gains the Blood Trail Debuff.

name: SMUSH
base_effect: Foot Soldier Damage Effect, Passive. Only applies to targets with 20% Health Bar or less. Cooldown: Once per round. You deal x2 the total damage.

upgrades.5: Smush activates at 30% Health Bar or less and deals x3 the total damage.
upgrades.10: This skill has no cooldown.
upgrades.15: Smush activates at 40% Health Bar or less and deals x4 the total damage.

name: TOSS
base_effect: Wrasslin' Damage Effect, Passive. You deal +1d8 base damage + Str Bludgeoning, end the Held Debuff, and throw the target 5 feet for every five Ranks (minimum 5 feet) you have in this Skill. You can only Toss foes of a smaller size than you.

upgrades.5: You can Toss foes up to your own size or smaller.
upgrades.10: You can Toss foes one size larger than you or smaller.
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage, and you can throw foes two sizes larger than you or smaller.

name: BOW
base_effect: Ranged attack. Requires two hands to wield. Each Attack requires proper ammunition.

upgrades.5: +1d6 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d6 base damage, and add 1 Rank damage die.
upgrades.15: +1d6 base damage, and the target gains the Blood Trail Debuff.

name: CROSSBOW
base_effect: Ranged attack. Requires two hands to wield. Each Attack requires proper ammunition. Cooldown: Once per round.

upgrades.5: +1d8 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d8 base damage, and the target gains the Blood Trail Debuff.
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage, and the range is 100 feet.

name: HANDGUN
base_effect: Ranged attack. Each Attack requires proper ammunition. Spend one Action to reload after a Major Fail or worse.

upgrades.5: +1d8 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d8 base damage
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage, and the target gains the Staggered Debuff.

name: JAVELIN
base_effect: Ranged attack with no additional limitation stated.

upgrades.5: +1d8 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d8 base damage, and this attack deals Armor-Piercing damage (ignores DR).
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage, and its range increases by your Strength score in feet.

name: SHOTGUN
base_effect: Ranged attack. Requires two hands to wield. Each Attack requires proper ammunition. Spend one Action to reload after a Major Fail or worse.

upgrades.5: +1d10 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d10 base damage
upgrades.15: +1d10 base damage, +5ft Splash

name: SHURIKEN
base_effect: Ranged attack. AI Favor: 1.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage, and the range is 40 feet.
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage, and you may make an extra free attack with Disadvantage.
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage, and you may make an extra free attack with Disadvantage.

name: SLINGSHOT
base_effect: Ranged attack. Requires two hands to wield. AI Favor: 2.

upgrades.5: +1d2 base damage, and its range increases by your Strength score in feet.
upgrades.10: +1d2 base damage, and add 1 Rank damage die.
upgrades.15: +1d2 base damage, and add 1 Rank damage die.

name: HERDING WEAPONS
base_effect: Reach melee attack (shepherd's crook and similar). Requires two hands to wield. AI Favor: 1.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage and you may slide the target 5 feet
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage, and you may use this skill to make a Sling attack with a range of 50 feet, but using Dex to hit.
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage, and the target gains the Take Down Debuff.

name: LANCE
base_effect: Reach melee attack. Must be mounted to use. Cannot be used in conjunction with Attack of Opportunity or Zone of Control Skills.

upgrades.5: +1d12 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d12 base damage, and +1 damage for every 10 feet your mount Moved this turn.
upgrades.15: +1d12 base damage, and +X damage, where X is the size of your mount.

name: POLEARM
base_effect: Reach melee attack. Requires two hands to wield.

upgrades.5: +1d8 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d8 base damage, and +1 Rank in the Zone of Control Skill.
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage, and +1 Rank in the Zone of Control Skill.

name: QUARTERSTAFF
base_effect: Reach melee attack. Requires two hands to wield.

upgrades.5: +1d6 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d6 base damage, and you gain a +1 Evade Buff.
upgrades.15: +1d6 base damage, and you gain a +1 Evade Buff.

name: Acute Ears
base_effect: Passive. Improves hearing and shows more Mobs on the HUD minimap, though the information is only somewhat reliable.

upgrades.5: Mob size and whether you have encountered them before are added to the red dot indicator.

name: AIMING
base_effect: Passive, used only in conjunction with Ranged Attacks. When making a Ranged Attack, you can add your Ranks in this Skill to your Attack Skill Check if you choose to make the Check with Disadvantage. On Success, add 1d4 to the damage. Mark for Advancement only when applying its Ranks to such an Attack.

upgrades.5: +1d4 damage
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage

name: Alchemy
base_effect: Used for crafting potions and poisons; you may craft potions up to a +5 bonus level.

upgrades.5: You may craft potions up to a +10 bonus level.
upgrades.10: You may create additional potions of the same kind without spending extra time.
upgrades.15: You can write the recipe for any potion you find.

name: Ambush
base_effect: When a Mob moves toward you, make an Int-Opposed Skill Check; on Success you gain a surprise Action against it before combat, attacking with Advantage as an unseen attacker.

upgrades.5: If you Attack with your Surprise Action, add an Ambush Rank damage die to that damage.
upgrades.10: When other crawlers in your party roll this skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).
upgrades.15: You gain a second bonus Action as a surprise Action, which cannot be an Attack.

name: Animal Handling
base_effect: Calm, befriend, and guide animals. Make an Int-Opposed Skill Check; on Success the animal is friendly enough to avoid attacking you.

upgrades.5: Choose an animal type to specialize in; you have Advantage on Animal Handling Checks against that type.
upgrades.10: Forming each level of bonding with a potential pet takes half the normal time.
upgrades.15: You can have up to two pets.

name: Arcane
base_effect: General knowledge of magic. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you can identify whether an item is magical.

upgrades.5: You can determine details such as the specific Rank and bonus levels of magical items.
upgrades.10: You can imbue items with inherent spells using an Arcanist Table.
upgrades.15: The default cooldown of your imbued spells is 3 hours.

name: Attack of Opportunity
base_effect: Passive, Interrupt. Requires a single-handed melee weapon with range no greater than 5 feet. When a foe moves out of an adjacent space (except via a Step), you may spend an Action to make an Attack Action as an Interrupt against that foe.

upgrades.5: If the foe moves into another space adjacent to you, they must stop.
upgrades.10: A foe using their Step no longer prevents this ability.
upgrades.15: Roll the Attack Skill Check with Advantage.

name: Backfire
base_effect: Compensated Anarchist Class only. Neutralize and deconstruct traps without a Sapper's Table; neutralizing takes 10 minutes and deconstructing takes 1 hour. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you take the trap apart and can repurpose it.

upgrades.5: You can identify when the trap was placed. Neutralizing takes 5 minutes.
upgrades.10: You can identify when the trap was created. Deconstructing takes 30 minutes.
upgrades.15: You can identify the designer of the trap. Deconstructing takes 15 minutes.

name: Balance
base_effect: Traverse tricky surfaces with ease. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you keep your balance on tricky or shifting surfaces.

upgrades.5: You may perform Move Actions in difficult terrain without penalty.
upgrades.10: When subject to a Take Down or involuntary Move effect, you may use this skill as a free Interrupt Action to avoid the effect.
upgrades.15: You may perform your Step on vertical surfaces, but must end it on a flat(ish) surface.

name: Basic Science
base_effect: Understand basic scientific principles and natural laws. Experiments take 2 hours; make an Unopposed Skill Check, and on Success you learn or confirm something.

upgrades.5: Experiments take 1 hour to perform.
upgrades.10: Choose a specialty (physics, biology, chemistry, Earth science, etc.) and roll with Advantage when dealing with it.
upgrades.15: Experiments take 30 minutes to perform.

name: Bomb Surgeon
base_effect: Deconstruct explosive bombs and smoke bombs, then use the half-sized bomb or its parts to craft new bombs. Takes 1 hour; with a Sapper's Table you need no Explosives Handling Check to avoid a mishap. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you have deconstructed it.

upgrades.5: Time required is 30 minutes.
upgrades.10: You never have to make an Explosives Handling Skill Check when using this skill.
upgrades.15: When cutting dynamite in half to make smaller bombs, round dice up. Time required is 15 minutes.

name: Calligraphy
base_effect: Make documents look elegant. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success what you have written is a joy to read and feels important.

upgrades.5: Roll with Advantage on your next Charisma Skill Check vs. the recipient of your beautiful paper.
upgrades.10: You can craft scrolls as if this were a crafting skill.
upgrades.15: Once per floor, you may craft a scroll for a spell you have only seen cast within the last 2 hours.

name: Cartography
base_effect: Map the dungeon. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you figure out where you are in relation to other things.

upgrades.5: You can always return from whence you came quickly, assuming the dungeon walls have not shifted.
upgrades.10: You provide an Advantage die to crawlers in your party (including you) making Tracking Checks or Checks relying on spatial relations.
upgrades.15: With merely a finger point or a 'thataway,' you can get from point A to point B via the most direct path.

name: Cat-Like Reflexes
base_effect: Limited Skill, only for cat-based Races such as Cat, Cat Girl/Cat Boy, and Tigran. You gain +10ft Move, and use this Skill Check when you would make a Dexterity Stat Check (vs. the typically lesser Stat Check Difficulty).

upgrades.5: Reduce damage you take from foes' Surprise Attacks against you by your Rank in this skill.
upgrades.10: Reduce all Area damage you take by 50% (rounded down).
upgrades.15: +10ft Move. You gain a +1 Evade Buff. Roll with Advantage to Evade Attacks and effects that would apply the Held Debuff (or similar) to you.

name: Cesta Punta
base_effect: Only acquired via an Earth Hobby Potion. Use this Skill Check when playing jai alai or throwing things that fit in the xistera; roll with Disadvantage at ranges over 500 feet.

upgrades.5: Throw range Strength x20 feet.
upgrades.10: Add 1 Cesta Punta Rank damage die to thrown damaging Attacks.
upgrades.15: Throw range Strength x30 feet, and roll with Disadvantage at ranges over 2,000 feet.

name: Character Actor
base_effect: Passive. Former Child Actor Class only; Rank increases by 1 when descending to a new floor only. At the start of each floor, choose a new Class from a random list of three provided by the GM and gain a random assortment of that Class's abilities for the floor, keeping your current ones; for each bullet-point line item in the new Class description, roll 1d2 and gain it on a 2.

upgrades.5: The random Classes increase in rarity and power based on the crawler's Stats and Level.
upgrades.10: Skill Ranks gained in any newly-granted Skills persist from floor to floor, but the starting Ranks of those Skills are lost.
upgrades.15: You choose the Class from any available.

name: Catcher
base_effect: Passive, Interrupt. When a Successful direct (non-Area) Attack is about to damage an ally, you leap in and take the damage instead; you must be adjacent to that ally but can take a 10ft Step first. You cannot use Evade, Shield Block, or other Skills or Spells to negate damage taken this way.

upgrades.5: You gain +5 DR when using this Skill.
upgrades.10: You gain +5 DR when using this Skill.
upgrades.15: You gain +5 DR when using this Skill and ignore any Debuffs attached to this damage.

name: Chopper Pilot
base_effect: Pilot a motorcycle (chopper) when racing, chasing, showing off, or doing stunts. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you stay upright while performing crazy maneuvers. You suffer Disadvantage on Attack Skill Checks while Piloting and cannot Attack with a two-handed weapon.

upgrades.5: Your chopper has +5ft Move.
upgrades.10: Attacking while piloting no longer suffers Disadvantage.
upgrades.15: Your chopper has +5ft Move. When performing crazy stunts (like riding up a canyon wall), roll with Advantage.

name: Climbing
base_effect: Climb dangerously (racing, chasing, rappelling from a burning building, etc.). Make an Unopposed Skill Check every minute; on Success you are safe and make progress. Attacking while Climbing suffers Disadvantage.

upgrades.5: Make a Check every 5 minutes.
upgrades.10: Make a Check every 10 minutes. You no longer Attack with Disadvantage while climbing.
upgrades.15: Make a Check every 15 minutes. When other crawlers in your party roll this skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).

name: Cockroach
base_effect: Limited Skill, only learned via a Race, Class, or item. Cooldown: once per scene. When an Attack would drop you to 0% Health Bar, roll an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you drop to 10% instead.

upgrades.5: No Skill Check required anymore.
upgrades.10: The crawler's Health Bar is unaffected by damage that would drop them to 0%.
upgrades.15: Cooldown is twice per scene. When it triggers, the crawler heals to 100% and has +Rank DR until the end of the next round of combat.

name: Cooking
base_effect: Skilled in the culinary arts. With ingredients and 1 hour to prepare, make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you make edible food for you and your party.

upgrades.5: It takes you 30 minutes to prepare a meal with makeshift ingredients.
upgrades.10: The diners gain the day-long 'You are full!' Buff: Heal 2 Health Bar slots per hour when not resting.
upgrades.15: The 'You are full!' Buff also causes Debuffs to end if you drop to 10% Health Bar.

name: Deception
base_effect: Obscure the truth when lying. Make an Int-Opposed Skill Check, with Disadvantage if the target has the Detect Lies Skill; on Success they believe you.

upgrades.5: You can use this Skill while gambling.
upgrades.10: You can use this Skill to forge documents.
upgrades.15: You know when you have been caught. If you fail this Check, you may perform one Action before your foes can react.

name: Detect Lies
base_effect: Detect lies. If you believe someone is lying, make a Cha-Opposed Skill Check, with Disadvantage if they possess Deception; on Success you sense if they are lying (if they believe they are telling the truth, you sense truth).

upgrades.5: When you Fail, you still cannot detect the lie, but you can ignore the additional effects of a Major Fail or worse.
upgrades.10: When you Fail, you cannot detect the lie, but you can ignore the effects of a Critical Fail.
upgrades.15: You do not need to see the speaker, allowing you to detect lies in text and audio form.

name: Detect Trap
base_effect: Check a room, door, chest, or other object for an active trap. Make an Unopposed Skill Check, with Disadvantage when scanning an entire room or while moving; on Success you are alerted to a non-magic trap, typically allowing you to avoid triggering it.

upgrades.5: You can detect magical traps.
upgrades.10: You no longer roll with Disadvantage when searching a broad area or while moving.
upgrades.15: When you are aware of nearby traps, your party has Advantage on their first Check to avoid or escape the effects.

name: Determine Value
base_effect: Passive. Ranks only increase by magical means. You can sort your HUD Inventory by item value, though the actual gold value is not displayed.

upgrades.5: Your Inventory is tabbed to sort items by type, and includes a history tab tracking item usage and former owners.
upgrades.10: You can determine what type of loot box the item would have come from.
upgrades.15: Whenever you add a new item to your Inventory, its gold value is displayed.

name: Diplomacy
base_effect: Mediate between opposing organizations and parties. Make an Int-Opposed Skill Check of the side with the higher Int Mod; on Success the two parties are willing to discuss options.

upgrades.5: Roll with Advantage if you are not a member of either party.
upgrades.10: Each side accepts consequences if they break the deal.
upgrades.15: Hostilities cease at least for the remainder of the day.

name: Dodge
base_effect: Passive. You gain a +1 Evade Buff. Mark the Skill for Advancement when Evading until Rank 5; after that Ranks only increase by magical means and training.

upgrades.5: Gain a +1 Evade Buff, and you may Step an additional 5 feet when you perform the Evade Action.
upgrades.10: Gain a +2 Evade Buff, and roll Evade with Advantage vs. Spells and Ranged Attacks.
upgrades.15: Gain a +2 Evade Buff, and you may perform the Evade Action without spending an Action in combat.

name: Double Tap
base_effect: Passive. Declare a Double Tap at the start of the combat round, before Mob Actions are determined, then use all your Actions this round to Attack a single target with the same weapon or Spell. If your first Attack is an Amazing Success or better, your second Attack (if it hits) is upgraded to a Critical Hit.

upgrades.5: Roll your first Attack with Advantage.
upgrades.10: If your first Attack is a Standard Success or better, the second Attack (if it hits) is upgraded to a Critical Hit.
upgrades.15: Roll your second Attack with Advantage. If your second Attack is a Critical Hit or upgraded to one, deal x3 damage (instead of x2).

name: Driving
base_effect: Drive dangerously (racing, chasing, showing off, etc.). Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you achieve your daredevil maneuver or avoid wrecking your vehicle. Attacking while Driving suffers Disadvantage.

upgrades.5: You no longer suffer Disadvantage when attacking while Driving.
upgrades.10: Your vehicle has +5ft Move. Roll with Advantage to Evade Attacks against your vehicle.
upgrades.15: Your vehicle has +5ft Move. When performing crazy stunts (like driving on only your left-side wheels), roll with Advantage.

name: Dumpster Diving
base_effect: Search dungeon clutter for interesting bits of rubbish. Takes 1 hour and can only be performed once per 50-foot-square area. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you find what you were looking for or another interesting item, determined by the GM.

upgrades.5: You also find 1 Rank damage die's-worth of Misc. Junk.
upgrades.10: A Dumpster Dive takes 30 minutes. On a Critical Hit, you gain an additional interesting item.
upgrades.15: A Dumpster Dive takes 10 minutes. On an Amazing Success, you gain an interesting item.

name: Endurance
base_effect: Prevent fatigue while grinding, walking long distances, or other extended strenuous activities. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you may continue and do not gain the Fatigued Debuff.

upgrades.5: You can ignore the effects of a Major Fail when making these Checks.
upgrades.10: If you are not Fatigued or in extreme conditions, you make this Check with Advantage.
upgrades.15: If your Check is a Critical Fail, you can take the effects of a Standard Fail.

name: Engineering
base_effect: Design and build things with moving parts, fluids, or chemicals wholly out of Misc. Junk with no inherent bonuses (e.g. a watch, water pump, or bullets); cannot create vehicles or high-powered engines. From the Fourth Floor, you may use an Engineering Table. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you create the item.

upgrades.5: Choose a mundane item type to specialize in. You have Advantage when creating an item of that type.
upgrades.10: You may craft your specialty item with a +1 bonus level enchantment.
upgrades.15: You may craft your specialty item with up to +2 bonus level enchantment, and it takes half the time.

name: Escape Artist
base_effect: Escape bonds or being Held. For bonds, make an Unopposed Skill Check; to escape being Held, make a Str-Opposed Skill Check. On Success you escape your bonds or the creature holding you.

upgrades.5: You can escape your bonds, and no one sees you do it. If you escape being Held, you can then take a Step (also unseen).
upgrades.10: When other crawlers in your party roll this skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).
upgrades.15: When you slip out, you may immediately take an Action with Advantage.

name: Escape Plan
base_effect: Passive. Ranks only advance by magical means. Your HUD reveals hidden doors and passages, unless they were crafted by someone with more Ranks in Fabricate or Engineering than you have in this Skill, or the passage is entirely natural.

upgrades.5: You have access to system-concealed displays and the Dungeon Locator, including holographic signs and arrows toward City and stronger Bosses.
upgrades.10: You can read hidden sigils (glowing blue circles) used by the showrunners to direct Mob movement.
upgrades.15: You can read hidden messages and redactions in dungeon documents.

name: Explosives Handling
base_effect: For making Attack Skill Checks with explosives. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you safely handle standard explosive devices.

upgrades.5: You can determine the type, status, and raw materials of explosives you handle.
upgrades.10: You can craft explosives such as dynamite as if this were a crafting Skill, though you must have explosive raw materials and a Sapper's Table.
upgrades.15: You may create explosive raw materials out of non-volatile materials. Your crafting takes half the time.

name: Fabricate
base_effect: Make generic, mundane items with no inherent bonuses wholly out of Misc. Junk (e.g. a ladder, 50ft rope, or ceramic pot); cannot create things with moving parts, fluids, or chemicals. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you create the item.

upgrades.5: Choose a mundane item to specialize in. You have Advantage when creating that item.
upgrades.10: You may craft your specialty item with a +1 bonus level enchantment.
upgrades.15: You may craft your specialty item with up to +2 bonus level enchantment, and it takes half the time.

name: Find Crawler
base_effect: Passive. Ranks only increase by magical means. Your HUD displays other crawlers within 1,000 feet of you, designated with a blue dot.

upgrades.5: The area in which you can detect other crawlers increases to 5 miles.
upgrades.10: The area in which you can detect other crawlers increases to 10 miles.
upgrades.15: You can input a specific crawler's name and learn their exact location anywhere in the dungeon.

name: Find Trap
base_effect: Passive. Ranks only increase by magical means and training. Traps within 5 feet of you appear on your HUD one second prior to triggering, which is often too late to react.

upgrades.5: Traps appear on your HUD up to 5 seconds before they are triggered.
upgrades.10: Traps within 10 feet of you appear on your HUD as you approach them.
upgrades.15: Traps within 15 feet of you appear on your HUD as you approach them.

name: First Aid
base_effect: Give minor medical aid to yourself or someone else. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success the patient regains 1 Health Bar slot, plus 1 additional slot per higher degree of Success. After you treat someone, you cannot treat them again until they complete a Short or Long Rest.

upgrades.5: If you spend 5 minutes, the patient also heals a Minor Injury Debuff.
upgrades.10: If you spend 10 minutes, the patient also heals a Long-Term Minor Injury Debuff.
upgrades.15: The patient regains 1 additional Health Bar slot. If you spend 15 minutes, the patient also heals a Major Injury Debuff.

name: Gear Head
base_effect: Limited Skill, only learned via a Race, Class, or item; requires an Engine Stand attachment to an Engineering Table (2,000 gold). Build high-performance engines using Crafting rules; each +5ft Move is a +1 Bonus Level at the default '10 + Bonus Level x4' Difficulty. On Success you have built a custom engine.

upgrades.5: You can add accessories to vehicles or even build your own custom vehicles, using Engineering crafting rules but this Skill, with no bonus level limits.
upgrades.10: Each +10ft Move is a +1 Bonus Level. You may use this Skill as a Repair Skill when fixing engines.
upgrades.15: Cut the time required to craft engines and vehicles you build around your engines in half.

name: Goblin Explosives
base_effect: For making Attack Skill Checks with explosives. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; Goblin Explosives are so unstable that Critical Fails occur on a Natural 1-4. On Success you safely use Goblin Explosive devices.

upgrades.5: Critical Fail occurs on a Natural 3 or less. You can determine the type, status, and raw materials of Goblin Explosives you handle.
upgrades.10: Critical Fail occurs on a Natural 2 or less. You can craft explosives such as dynamite as if this were a crafting Skill, though you must have explosive raw materials and a Sapper's Table.
upgrades.15: Critical Fail occurs on a Natural 1 as usual. You may create explosive raw materials out of non-volatile materials with a Sapper's Table. Your crafting takes half the time.

name: Good First Impression
base_effect: Does not work on crawlers, Bosses, or Elites, and only against individuals, not groups. When you encounter an NPC or Mob that is not immediately hostile or attacking, make an Int-Opposed Skill Check; on Success the Mob approaches with wary curiosity.

upgrades.5: A Mob lower level than you will not attack your party unless attacked by a member of your party.
upgrades.10: A Mob up to double your level will not attack your party unless attacked by you or an ally, or your party is preventing them from completing their objective.
upgrades.15: A group of Mobs of the same type up to double your level will not attack your party unless attacked by a member of your party, or your party is preventing them from completing their objective.

name: Hide in Shadows
base_effect: While in a heavily shadowed area or out of sight, stay still and foil foes' chances to spot you (to move while avoiding detection, see Stealth). Make an Int-Opposed Skill Check, with Advantage if hiding behind an object larger than you; on Success you become invisible to Mobs and other crawlers' HUDs, though still affected by environmental and Area Attacks, and become visible if you take an Action affecting another creature or are no longer behind cover.

upgrades.5: You can use this Skill in a dim light without having an object to hide behind.
upgrades.10: When other crawlers in your party roll this Skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).
upgrades.15: You can use this Skill in a lightly shaded area and may make a Step without giving away your position.

name: Improvised Explosive Device
base_effect: Manipulate explosive material into bombs and traps without a Sapper's Table (you literally cannot use one, so make an Explosives Handling Skill Check to avoid issues). Use Crafting rules; on Success you create the device, which can have timers and triggering devices more sophisticated than a burning fuse.

upgrades.5: Your crafting takes half the time.
upgrades.10: Your devices deal d10s of damage instead of d6s (the default).
upgrades.15: Your devices can be set to trigger only against a specific Mob, Boss, NPC, or crawler.

name: Incendiary Device Handling
base_effect: For making Attack Skill Checks with incendiary devices. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you can safely handle incendiary devices.

upgrades.5: You can determine the type, status, and raw materials of incendiary devices you handle.
upgrades.10: You can craft incendiary devices as if this were a crafting Skill, though you must have incendiary raw materials and a Sapper's Table.
upgrades.15: Add a +5 Splash to your crafted device at no additional Difficulty, and your crafting takes half the time.

name: Infusion
base_effect: Requires an Infusion Station attachment on an Alchemy Table or Tier 3 Sapper's Table. Infuse potion bonuses onto consumable items; one potion infuses one item. On Success your consumable item now does more.

upgrades.5: One potion can infuse 2 items at once.
upgrades.10: One potion can infuse 5 items at once.
upgrades.15: One potion can infuse 10 items at once.

name: Intimidate
base_effect: Scare a foe. Make a Cha-Opposed Skill Check, with Disadvantage if either side has attacked or taken a hostile stance in this encounter; on Success the target gains the Staggered Debuff.

upgrades.5: On Success or greater, until the end of the next round, the target can only use its remaining Actions to move away from you (though it does not need to use its Step).
upgrades.10: The target also gains the Woozy Debuff.
upgrades.15: The target drops everything they were holding and also gains the Paralyzed Debuff.

name: Investigation
base_effect: Spend 10 minutes looking at an area or puzzle. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; when you take the Look for Clues Action, spend only one Action to use this Skill. On Success you learn something useful.

upgrades.5: If you are familiar with the area you are investigating, you can make the Skill Check with Advantage.
upgrades.10: Each attempt takes 5 minutes.
upgrades.15: Roll with Advantage if you know the parties involved (e.g. you know the puzzle's maker, or the murder victim and the main suspect).

name: Iron Stomach
base_effect: Eat magic items. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you eat the item and it is destroyed. On an Amazing Success or better, gain 1 permanent Intelligence. Beware cursed items, which could have negative effects.

upgrades.5: On a Critical Hit, gain 1 additional permanent Intelligence.
upgrades.10: On a Standard Success or better, gain 1 permanent Intelligence. You may eat cursed items with no ill effects.
upgrades.15: You choose which Stat is permanently increased.

name: Jumping
base_effect: With a running start of at least 10 feet (made as a 10-foot Step with this Action), leap in an arcing trajectory. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you leap up to your Rank + Str in feet, with a height of 1ft.

upgrades.5: Add your Dex to the height of your Jump.
upgrades.10: You gain a +1 Evade Buff.
upgrades.15: Your leap distance in feet is Rank + [Str x2].

name: Leadership
base_effect: Coordinate two or more separate parties during fights against Bosses. Make an Int-Opposed Skill Check; on Success the parties have Advantage on their first Attack against the Boss.

upgrades.5: You may instead use this Skill during Skill challenges while on a group Quest. Perform a free Call a Play Action, extending to each member of the parties during their next non-combat Skill Check.
upgrades.10: Instead of Advantage, anyone in the parties may perform a free Move Action.
upgrades.15: Instead of Advantage, anyone in the parties may perform a free Evade Action.

name: Light on Your Feet
base_effect: Usable only by animals. With a running start of at least 10 feet (made as a 10ft Step), leap in an arcing trajectory. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you leap up to your Rank x2 in feet, with a height equal to your Dex x2 in feet.

upgrades.5: Your distance is Rank x3 and your height is Dex x3.
upgrades.10: You may leap without an arcing trajectory, allowing for 'straight up.'
upgrades.15: Your leap may last up to your Rank in seconds, which resembles gliding.

name: Lockpicking
base_effect: Pick a lock, spending the Floor number in minutes. Roll with Disadvantage without proper tools, unless it is a crude lock. Make an Unopposed Skill Check (a lock by a named antagonist may be Int-Opposed); on Success you pick the lock.

upgrades.5: You make no noise and leave no trace.
upgrades.10: Each attempt takes half the time. You may alter the lock so the key no longer works.
upgrades.15: You do not roll with Disadvantage if you lack the proper tools.

name: Lore
base_effect: Studied the goings-on in the Dungeon. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you know a little something about a neighborhood, some of the Mobs, or how to avoid angering the locals.

upgrades.5: You can identify the major factions in the area.
upgrades.10: You are aware of the important local NPCs.
upgrades.15: You roll with Advantage on your first Charisma-based Skill Check when encountering an organized group in a neighborhood.

name: Negotiation
base_effect: Spend 5 minutes haggling over prices or negotiating terms; does not work on members of your own party, and some items have a minimum price. Haggling with non-merchants is at Disadvantage. Make an Int-Opposed Skill Check; on Success you increase or decrease the price 10% in your favor, or the opponent tentatively agrees to your terms.

upgrades.5: Your party members can also buy or sell at your newly-negotiated price.
upgrades.10: Increase or decrease the price by an additional 10% in your favor.
upgrades.15: Increase or decrease the price by an additional 15% in your favor.

name: Pathfinder
base_effect: Passive. Ranks only increase by magical means and training. Your HUD map zooms out with a thought, by a multiplier equal to your Rank (e.g. Rank 4 covers x4 the standard area, extending to 1 mile around you).

upgrades.5: You are notified when you are near a saferoom or stairwell.
upgrades.10: You can see through your map while it is open in your HUD.
upgrades.15: Mobs appear as red dots on your HUD map.

name: Perception
base_effect: Concentrate your senses to pick out details others might miss, including when you take a Look for Clues Action. Make an Unopposed Skill Check (Difficulty adjusted for lighting, clutter, speed, etc.); on Success you notice something.

upgrades.5: Halve the penalty for cluttered areas.
upgrades.10: Halve the penalty for how short of a window you have to notice the thing.
upgrades.15: Halve the penalty for the range to the thing.

name: Performance
base_effect: Act, dance, play an instrument, sing, or deliver slam poetry to electrify an audience; choose a performance type to specialize in. Make an Unopposed Skill Check (adding the top rival's Cha to Difficulty if competing); on Success you command the stage and the audience is entertained.

upgrades.5: Choose an additional type of performance to specialize in.
upgrades.10: Choose an additional type of performance. You can coach and coordinate others in one of your specialties; after at least 1 hour of coaching, they can attempt an unskilled Performance Skill Check without Disadvantage.
upgrades.15: Choose an additional type of performance. You can mimic someone else's performance after experiencing it once.

name: Persuasion
base_effect: Get others to see things your way, typically needing about 10 minutes of schmoozing in a safe environment. Make an Int-Opposed Skill Check; on Success you convince the target to follow your suggestion if it is not too costly, too dangerous, or against their nature.

upgrades.5: They will follow your suggestion even if it is costly for them.
upgrades.10: They will follow your suggestion even if it is dangerous.
upgrades.15: They will follow your suggestion even if it is against their nature.

name: Regeneration
base_effect: Passive. If your Rank in this Skill is equal to or greater than your Con, you heal 1 Health Bar slot at the start of each round (or every 10 seconds outside combat); if not, you heal 1 Health Bar slot every other round (or every 20 seconds outside combat).

upgrades.5: After 5 minutes, any Minor Injury Debuff you suffer from ends. After 10 minutes, any Major Injury Debuff you suffer from ends.
upgrades.10: After 20 minutes, any Long-Term Minor Injury Debuff you suffer from ends. After 1 hour, any Long-Term Major Injury Debuff you suffer from ends.
upgrades.15: The time required to end injury Debuffs is halved.

name: Religion
base_effect: Understand gods, their followers, and what makes them tick. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you know basic information about a god and the practices of their followers.

upgrades.5: You can identify the followers on sight, even if they are trying to hide their affiliation.
upgrades.10: You know how to sow discord among the followers of that religion.
upgrades.15: You know strengths and weaknesses of the gods.

name: Repair
base_effect: For basic repairs to items with no moving parts, magical or not. After spending 2 hours, you can repair most simple items that are broken or damaged but not destroyed. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you repair the item.

upgrades.5: You can make repairs to things with moving parts.
upgrades.10: You can make repairs in 1 hour.
upgrades.15: You can rebuild a destroyed item.

name: Riding
base_effect: Ride a living beast mount; the rider in control rolls Attack Skill Checks with Disadvantage. You can ride to a local watering hole without a Check, but during an action scene or exploring dangerous terrain your mount might panic. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success your mount does not stumble and you stay upright.

upgrades.5: Your mount has +5ft Move. You no longer suffer Disadvantage when attacking while Riding.
upgrades.10: Your mount has an additional +10ft Move. When other crawlers in your party roll this Skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).
upgrades.15: Your mount has an additional +15ft Move. When performing crazy stunts (like jumping through flames), roll with Advantage.

name: Ropework
base_effect: Tie good knots (e.g. to tie people up, climb, or cattle-rustle). Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you rope the thing with a good knot.

upgrades.5: You can now use this Skill as an Attack, at a Range of 10ft vs. the target's Evade. On Success, the target gains the Held Debuff.
upgrades.10: You can whip your line in that special way to untie a knot you made and recover your rope.
upgrades.15: Your Attack now has a Range of your Strength (min 15). Just make sure your rope is long enough.

name: Running
base_effect: For short bursts of running (for extended runs, use Endurance). For racing, chasing, or fleeing, make an Unopposed Skill Check every minute, adding 1 to your result for every 10ft of Move you have; on Success you succeed in the run.

upgrades.5: You have a permanent +5ft Move Buff. Make a Check every 2 minutes.
upgrades.10: You have an additional permanent +10ft Move Buff. Make a Check every 4 minutes.
upgrades.15: You have an additional permanent +15ft Move Buff. Make a Check every 6 minutes.

name: Salvage
base_effect: Collect useful items from things you have deconstructed or failed to properly craft; cannot be used with explosive devices. Usually takes 1 hour; at the end, make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success you recover half of the important raw materials.

upgrades.5: Your Salvage Checks take 30 minutes.
upgrades.10: On Success, you recover all of the important raw materials.
upgrades.15: On a crafting Standard Fail or Near Miss, roll your crafting Check again with Advantage, with an additional 15-minute time expenditure.

name: Scutelliphily
base_effect: Limited Skill, only learned via a Race, Class, or item. You know your way around patches and love collecting them. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you can identify a patch and its bonus level, if any.

upgrades.5: You can sew and iron patches onto clothing using this Skill.
upgrades.10: You may use this as a crafting Skill, but crafting tables provide no bonuses. Enchanted patches are limited to one per Gear slot and do not take up Accessory slots.
upgrades.15: Your crafting Checks take half the time. Increase the bonus value of your enchantments with this Skill by 1, at no additional Difficulty or time to craft (e.g. a +2 Strength patch becomes +3).

name: Shield Block
base_effect: Interrupt. Requires wielding a shield; cannot be used against Area of Effect damage. When attacked by a physical Attack, spend one Action to make a separate Shield Block Skill Check vs. the Mob's 'to hit' for each Attack targeting you. On Success, take half the damage before applying DR; your Shield takes a -1 DR penalty on a Major Fail and -2 on a Critical Fail, breaking at 0 DR.

upgrades.5: You may also use this Skill against Spells and magical damage.
upgrades.10: On a Critical Hit, you may make a Shield Bash Attack as a free melee-range Interrupt Attack (instead of Advantage on your next Attack) if you wish, dealing 3d6 base damage + Str Bludgeoning.
upgrades.15: +1d6 Shield Bash damage. Further reduce the damage you would take by your Str Mod.

name: Sleight of Hand
base_effect: Manipulate small objects without being spotted; items must be smaller than your hand, and you cannot access others' Inventories or Hotlists. Make an Int-Opposed Skill Check, with Disadvantage if someone's Perception Rank is higher than your Sleight of Hand; on Success you maneuver the item without being noticed.

upgrades.5: You may attempt to pick the pockets of NPCs and Mobs.
upgrades.10: You may attempt to plant items on someone with pockets or the equivalent.
upgrades.15: You may manipulate items up to half your own size (rounded down).

name: Smithing
base_effect: Craft mundane items such as horseshoes, railroad spikes, nails, or armor and weapons, but without DR or any bonuses.

upgrades.5: You may craft items up to a +5 bonus.
upgrades.10: You may craft items up to a +10 bonus.
upgrades.15: Your crafting with this Skill takes half the time.

name: Stealth
base_effect: Move undetected or surprise a Mob; you must be out of sight of all foes to begin. Make an Int-Opposed Skill Check. On Success before combat, you are unnoticed and gain 1 non-Attack Action (plus your 10ft Step); in a non-combat situation you remain unnoticed and can perform a Move Action with a 10ft Step as part of this Check.

upgrades.5: Your surprise Action can be an Attack with Advantage.
upgrades.10: When other crawlers in your party roll this Skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).
upgrades.15: On a successful Surprise Check, you may also take a full Move and Step. If you Attack with your Surprise Action, deal x2 the base damage dice.

name: Streetwise
base_effect: In populated areas, learn or spread rumors, avoid attracting too much attention, gain access to less-than-legal items, and the like. Make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you navigate a town without attracting attention, deal with a criminal network, identify an informal power structure, or gain the information you are seeking.

upgrades.5: You also hear an additional rumor, as determined by the GM. Or spread one!
upgrades.10: You also quickly find a hiding place determined by the GM.
upgrades.15: You also uncover information that might give you some leverage on an important person in town determined by the GM.

name: Survival
base_effect: Survive in dangerous, often remote places for long periods with only meager food and water you can rustle up. When traveling through such areas, make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you survive the perils unscathed, while on a standard Fail you suffer hunger and/or thirst effects.

upgrades.5: You do not suffer additional damage from a Critical Fail.
upgrades.10: When other crawlers in your party roll this Skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).
upgrades.15: You do not suffer additional damage from a Major Fail.

name: Swimming
base_effect: Use when there are consequences for not swimming strongly (racing for your life, strong current, avoiding a waterfall), not for a casual swim. Make an Unopposed Skill Check every 30 seconds; on Success you swim well despite the danger. After 1 minute of Swimming (Success or Fail), or immediately on a Major Fail or worse, gain the Fatigued Debuff.

upgrades.5: After 2 minutes of Swimming (Success or Fail), gain the Fatigued Debuff.
upgrades.10: You can swim at your full Move rate as an Action, but you still cannot take a 10ft Step.
upgrades.15: Make this Check every 5 minutes, and only gain the Fatigue Debuff on a Critical Fail.

name: Tactics
base_effect: A crawler may attempt this Skill Check only once per combat. Choose one combat discipline (Attack, Damage, or Evade) and make an Unopposed Skill Check; on Success you and each party member gain a +1 bonus to Checks for the chosen discipline, increased by +1 per higher degree of Success.

upgrades.5: If you observe the foes and battlefield for at least 5 minutes prior to combat, roll this Skill Check with Advantage.
upgrades.10: After using this Skill during a combat, you roll 2d10 when you Call a Play (still choose one die).
upgrades.15: The bonus applies to all three combat disciplines instead of just one.

name: Tattoo Artistry
base_effect: Stick and poke ink under someone's skin to create a mundane tattoo (see Crafting for magical tattoos).

upgrades.5: You may craft tattoos with up to a +5 bonus.
upgrades.10: You may craft tattoos with up to a +10 bonus.
upgrades.15: Your crafting with this Skill takes half the time.

name: Taunt
base_effect: Interrupt. With a shout and obscene gesture, draw enemies' ire within 30 feet. After seeing where Mob Attacks are headed, make an Int-Opposed Skill Check; on Success you Taunt one Attack of your choosing away from any target onto you, with higher degrees of Success Taunting additional Attacks.

upgrades.5: You may make a free Evade Check against each Taunted Attack (roll separately vs. each Attack as usual). Then you may still spend an Action to Evade other Attacks and reroll any Fails from your free Evades.
upgrades.10: You can affect Mobs within 60 feet.
upgrades.15: Your free Evade Checks against Taunted Attacks are made with Advantage.

name: Throwing
base_effect: Throw objects up to your Str in pounds at up to your Str x10 feet (heavier/bulkier items at Disadvantage, at GM discretion). To hit a target area, make an Unopposed Skill Check; to hit a foe, make an Attack Skill Check vs. the target's Evade. On Success you hit the target; on Fail, roll 1d8 for direction, landing the missed-by distance away in feet.

upgrades.5: You have Advantage when Throwing to a target who wants to catch what you are selling.
upgrades.10: Choose the direction on a miss, rather than roll.
upgrades.15: Your Throw range is your Str x20 feet.

name: Tracking
base_effect: Find and follow tracks. Make an Unopposed Skill Check to find tracks, then another Tracking Check every 15 minutes to continue following them; on Success you find the tracks or continue following them.

upgrades.5: You can follow found tracks for 30 minutes before making a new Check, and gain 1 piece of information about the target(s).
upgrades.10: You can follow found tracks for 1 hour before making a new Check, and gain 2 pieces of information about the target(s).
upgrades.15: You can follow found tracks for 2 hours before making a new Check, and gain 4 pieces of information about the target(s).

name: Trap Engineer
base_effect: Craft traps via a Sapper's Table with a Trap Module (3,000 gold).

upgrades.5: Roll with Advantage when making non-explosive traps.
upgrades.10: Your traps can be set to trigger only against a specific Mob, Boss, NPC, or crawler.
upgrades.15: Add a +5 Splash to your trap at no additional Difficulty, and your crafting takes half the time.

name: Zone of Control
base_effect: Passive. Must be wielding a Reach weapon. Once per round, when an enemy enters a space adjacent to you for the first time, you may perform an Interrupt Attack against them at a cost of one Action, made with Disadvantage.

upgrades.5: Your Attack is no longer made with Disadvantage.
upgrades.10: The target is pushed 5 feet.
upgrades.15: Make your Attack Skill Check with Advantage.

name: AIR BUDDY
base_effect: Launches you forward to fly up to 10 x your Int Mod, landing safely on solid ground; can be cast twice in a row to double jump.

upgrades.5: You may choose one additional willing target up to your size at touch range, who you bring with you.
upgrades.10: You can fly up to 20 x your Int Mod away with this spell.
upgrades.15: You may choose up to five additional willing targets up to your size at touch range to bring with you.

name: ASTRAL PAW (ASTRAL HAND, ASTRAL CLAW)
base_effect: Conjures a spectral hand, paw, or claw up to 30ft away that can manipulate objects and make Skill Checks at Disadvantage, lasting until end of combat or 5 minutes.

upgrades.5: Your Pugilism and Slice Attacks with the Paw add 1 Astral Paw Rank damage die.
upgrades.10: You can conjure a paw up to four size categories larger than your own, and the range increases to 50 feet.
upgrades.15: The caster no longer suffers Disadvantage when performing suitable Skill Checks using the paw, and the duration is 15 minutes.

name: BAD FAITH
base_effect: An unholy presence invades the victim's mind, body, and soul. Attack, Necrotic, Favored: Cleric.

upgrades.5: +1d8 base damage, +5ft Splash
upgrades.10: +1d8 base damage, and end all Buffs on the victims for the duration of the combat.
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage, +5ft Splash

name: BANG BRO
base_effect: Places a hot, crackling temporary enchantment on a weapon you are holding for 5 minutes + 1 minute per Rank, with a 15-minute cooldown.
base_damage: +2 mixed Fire and Electric damage to the enchanted weapon

upgrades.5: +1d6 Fire and Electric damage
upgrades.10: +1d6 Fire and Electric damage, and on an Amazing Success, the target of the weapon attack gains the Burned Debuff.
upgrades.15: +1d6 Fire and Electric damage, and on an Amazing Success, the target of the weapon attack also gains the Shocked Debuff.

name: CLOCKWORK TRIPLICATE
base_effect: Cast on a pet or minion, it splits into three, each with its full complement of abilities; you must spend an Action and make an Unopposed Animal Handling Skill Check to command each one separately. Duration 1 minute per Rank.

upgrades.5: Duration is 2 minutes per Rank.
upgrades.10: Duration is 3 minutes per Rank.
upgrades.15: When you command your pet or minion, the clockwork versions follow suit.

name: CONFUSING FOG
base_effect: Creates a 25 x 25ft billowing fog that you, party members, and friendly NPCs can see through, but Mobs attack targets in it with Disadvantage, lasting until the end of two full rounds or 20 seconds, with a 15-minute cooldown.

upgrades.5: The fog fills a 50 x 50ft area, and its duration is 1 minute.
upgrades.10: The fog fills a 100 x 100ft area and lasts for 5 minutes.
upgrades.15: The fog fills a 500 x 500ft area and lasts for 15 minutes.

name: DIRT CLOD
base_effect: Hurls a magical clod of dirt at the target, leaving dirt and pebbles strewn about near the target. Attack, Bludgeoning, AI Favor: 2.

upgrades.5: +2d2 base damage
upgrades.10: +1d2 base damage, and the target gains the Woozy Debuff.
upgrades.15: +1d2 base damage, and 1 Rank damage die.

name: DRAIN LIFE
base_effect: For a brief instant, creates a disgusting blood vein that reaches out and wraps itself around your target. Attack, Necrotic.

upgrades.5: +1d6 base damage, and if the target loses at least 3 Health Bar slots, you heal 1 Health Bar slot.
upgrades.10: +1d6 base damage, and if you heal this way, heal +1 Health Bar slot.
upgrades.15: +1d6 base damage, and if you heal this way, heal +1 Health Bar slot.

name: EARWORM
base_effect: Sing a terrible song targeting a victim's ear holes, usable once per round. Attack, Sonic, Favored: Bard.

upgrades.5: +1d6 base damage.
upgrades.10: +1d6 base damage, and the target gains the Queasy Debuff.
upgrades.15: +1d6 base damage and +10ft Splash.

name: FEAR
base_effect: Targets a non-Boss Mob of half your level or less; on a Standard Success it stands its ground but loses its Dex Mod for the combat, and on a higher success it uses two Actions next round to run away. Scary-ass Mobs are immune (GM's discretion). Attack, Mind Control.

upgrades.5: +5ft Blast radius.
upgrades.10: +5ft Blast radius, and on a Critical Hit, the affected creatures gain the Paralyzed Debuff.
upgrades.15: +5ft Blast radius.

name: FIRE FINGERS
base_effect: Brilliant flame leaps from your fingers at melee range. Attack, Fire, AI Favor: 1.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage.
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage, and the target gains the Burned Debuff.
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage, and your hands begin to intermittently burn. Your Pugilism, Unarmed Combat, and Slice Attack strikes add 1 Fire Fingers Rank damage die (Fire).

name: FIREBALL
base_effect: A slow, beach ball-sized sphere of fire emanates from you, attacked with Disadvantage. Each creature in the blast radius takes full damage when the impact zone is determined; on a Fail, roll 1d8 for direction and the miss amount is the distance in feet it impacts.

upgrades.5: +1d12 base damage. Those who lose 1 or more Health Bar slots via this attack gain the Burned Debuff.
upgrades.10: +1d12 base damage and becomes an 80ft Line attack (and keeps the Blast).
upgrades.15: +1d12 base damage and +40ft Splash (on the Blast).

name: FROST SCAR
base_effect: With a slice of your frigid hand, you leave a scar of rime on your target.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage, and the target cannot heal themselves in the next combat round.
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage, and the target gains the Stiff Legs Debuff.
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage, and the target gains The Taint Debuff.

name: GRAND ILLUSION
base_effect: You create an illusion that might trick your foes. Make a single Int-Opposed Spell Check vs. foes who can see it, using the same roll against foes who see it even after the casting round; on Success, they believe it.

upgrades.5: Those who believe gain the Woozy Debuff or similar based on the desired response.
upgrades.10: Those who believe also gain the Queasy Debuff or similar based on the desired response.
upgrades.15: Those who believe also gain the Shocked Debuff or similar based on the desired response.

name: HEAL
base_effect: You heal 2 Health Bar slots on yourself. This spell is Rank 1 maximum.

name: HEAL CRITTER
base_effect: The target pet or minion glows and heals back to 100% Health Bar.

upgrades.5: The target mends a Minor Injury Debuff.
upgrades.10: The target mends a Major Injury Debuff.
upgrades.15: The target regrows all lost appendages.

name: HEAL OTHERS
base_effect: A wave of positive vibes engulfs the target, healing them. It cannot be cast on yourself, pets, or minions.

upgrades.5: The target heals 1d6 Health Bar slots.
upgrades.10: The target heals 2d6 Health Bar slots.
upgrades.15: Instead of a single target, all party members within a 20ft Burst radius are healed.

name: HEAL SELF
base_effect: You center yourself and use magic to make yourself whole, healing Health Bar slots. It can only be cast on yourself.

upgrades.5: You heal 1d6 Health Bar slots and mend a Minor Injury, Poison, or Disease Debuff.
upgrades.10: You heal 2d6 Health Bar slots and mend a Major Injury or other Debuff.
upgrades.15: You heal to full and gain the benefits of a short rest.

name: HOLE
base_effect: You create a temporary cylindrical hole in a surface or material within range, to a depth of 1 inch per Spell Rank and a diameter of 2ft. Anything that fits can pass through if the hole is deep enough to penetrate the surface; it cannot be used on saferoom doors or living things.

upgrades.5: You can reduce the diameter of the hole to a smaller size when cast.
upgrades.10: You can widen the hole's diameter by 1 inch for every inch of depth you sacrifice when cast.
upgrades.15: The caster may end the spell with a thought (like an Interrupt, but it doesn't cost an Action). Anything in the hole at that time is destroyed.

name: HOLY AURA
base_effect: You channel your deity and emanate their essence to hurt only the enemies around you.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage, and affected undead Mobs take double damage.
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage and +5ft Burst radius.
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage and +5ft Burst radius.

name: HOT STUFF AURA
base_effect: You create a shield of pure sex appeal around you against all damage types, with a number of Health Bar slots equal to your Cha Mod and a 2 in each slot. It also protects all allies within the radius, disappears when depleted, and its slots cannot be healed.

upgrades.5: Increase the Health to 4 in each slot.
upgrades.10: +5ft Burst radius, with a 6 in each slot.
upgrades.15: +10ft Burst radius, with a 8 in each slot.

name: ICE BLAST
base_effect: With the howl of blizzard winds, you let loose a compact pocket of freezing cold and ice.

upgrades.5: +1d8 base damage.
upgrades.10: +1d8 base damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from you.
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage, and you can change the range to a 15ft Cone Attack.

name: ICICLES
base_effect: Seizing upon the ice that runs through your veins, icicle projectiles shoot forth from your palms towards distant foes.

upgrades.5: +1d12 base damage.
upgrades.10: +1d12 base damage, and the target gains the Stiff Legs Debuff.
upgrades.15: +1d12 base damage, and the damage is Armor-Piercing.

name: INTIMATE TOUCHES
base_effect: You lay hands on the target (which could be you), who heals Health Bar slots equal to your Cha Mod. Unlike most healing, this spell is not an Interrupt.

upgrades.5: The target also heals a Minor Injury Debuff.
upgrades.10: The target also heals a Major Injury Debuff.
upgrades.15: The target also heals all Poison & Disease Debuffs.

name: LIGHTNING BOLT
base_effect: With a thunderous clap, you let loose a bolt of lightning.

upgrades.5: +1d10 base damage.
upgrades.10: +1d10 base damage and becomes a 100ft Line Attack.
upgrades.15: +1d10 base damage. The lightning bolt forks, and you may apply your Attack against any number of additional targets within 15 feet of the previous target (within the range limit); each successful Attack, including against the primary target, deals half damage.

name: MAGIC MISSILE
base_effect: From glowing eyes, fingers, or whatever, a streak of pure force shoots out.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage, and you can cast the Spell at a higher or lower Mana cost. 3 Mana: -4 damage. 4 Mana: -2 damage. 6 Mana: Add 1 Rank damage die.
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage, and the missiles deal Force and Fire damage. The target gains the Burned Debuff.
upgrades.15: This attack deals base damage x3.

name: MIND TICKLE
base_effect: You infect your target with a small headache.

upgrades.5: +1d2 base damage.
upgrades.10: +1d2 base damage, and the target gains the Sore as Shit Debuff.
upgrades.15: +1d2 base damage, and the target gains the Muted Debuff.

name: MINION ARMY
base_effect: Choose a target within range; on a Standard Success, 1 in 50 Mobs in the affected area (min 1) become an ally and fight for you without needing to be commanded, with higher success turning additional Mobs. It has a 5-minute casting time, the caster cannot move while casting, and it only works against Mobs with Intelligence 2+.

upgrades.5: The casting time is 4 minutes. Duration is 5 minutes.
upgrades.10: Add your Charisma Stat to the Burst radius. Duration is 10 minutes.
upgrades.15: Add your Charisma Stat to the Burst radius. Duration is 15 minutes.

name: NATURE'S BREATH
base_effect: You blow cool, fresh air over the target's wounds (could be yourself), healing them a number of Health Bar slots equal to a Nature's Breath Rank damage die roll. It may also target pets and minions.

upgrades.5: Add 1 to your die roll.
upgrades.10: Add 1 to your die roll, and remove a Minor Injury Debuff.
upgrades.15: Add 1 to your die roll, and remove a Major Injury Debuff.

name: OAKHIDE
base_effect: Your skin turns into solid wood, giving you +2 Damage Resistance for the duration of this spell.

upgrades.5: +2 DR. Duration is 3 minutes.
upgrades.10: +2 DR. You may target party members and NPCs up to 10 feet away with this spell.
upgrades.15: +2 DR. Duration is 4 minutes.

name: PALADIN'S SMITE
base_effect: You channel a torrent of divine wrath toward a soon-to-be repentant foe.

upgrades.5: +1d8 base damage.
upgrades.10: +1d8 base damage, and the target gains the Take Down Debuff.
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage, and the damage is Armor-Piercing (ignores DR).

name: PANTY DROPPER
base_effect: Make an Int-Opposed Spell Check against a non-Boss target, even in combat. On Success, the target wants to jump your bones and won't let anyone stop them (they cease attacking or doing other things).

upgrades.5: The duration is 5 minutes.
upgrades.10: The duration is 10 minutes.
upgrades.15: The duration is 15 minutes.

name: PING
base_effect: Sends out an audible ping that gives the distance and location of all non-crawlers and non-red-tagged Mobs in a circle around you, marking targets beyond map range with 'somewhat complete' information. Targets hear the ping but do not know where it originated; environmental factors and obstacles may increase or decrease range.

upgrades.5: If you know the Fear Spell, you may cast it at no Action cost to affect all eligible Mobs within the Ping range. You only pay the Mana.
upgrades.10: Environmental factors and obstacles no longer decrease the range, and you receive 'mostly complete' information.
upgrades.15: You pay no Mana to add the Fear Spell, and you receive 'entirely complete' information.

name: PROTECTIVE SHELL
base_effect: You create a 10 + Int-foot Burst radius magic shell around yourself and nearby party members. The shell pushes away all Mobs in its Area (shell radius + 5ft); Mobs cannot enter it (unless non-corporeal) or physically attack those inside, though it does not protect against magic effects, and crawlers inside may attack as usual. It must be imbued onto something you are wearing and cannot be moved.

upgrades.5: Duration is 10 seconds. In addition to knocking enemies away, it protects the occupants from all non-Spell attacks originating from outside the shell until the end of the current combat round.
upgrades.10: Duration is 20 seconds or two rounds.
upgrades.15: Duration is 30 seconds or three rounds.

name: PUDDLE JUMPER
base_effect: You and up to 3 party members of your choice teleport to another location, with a 10-second delay before the effect takes place and a tingling sensation while waiting.

upgrades.5: The delay is 2 seconds, and the destination doesn't have to be a surface.
upgrades.10: The delay is 1 second, and the destination can be anywhere within 1,000 yards in any direction, even if the exact destination cannot be seen.
upgrades.15: There is no delay, and the destination can be anywhere within 1 mile in any direction, even if the exact destination cannot be seen.

name: RISE, DEAD MINION!
base_effect: At your command, a Medium (4) size skeleton emerges from the ground to attack your foe in melee combat. After the Attack, the skeleton collapses, creating difficult terrain in the space it occupied.

upgrades.5: The skeleton attacks twice before collapsing.
upgrades.10: The skeleton increases to size Large (5), and its Attack range is 10 feet. +1d8 base damage.
upgrades.15: The skeleton increases to size Colossal (7), and its Attack range is 15 feet. Add one Rise, Dead Minion! Rank damage die to the damage.

name: ROOTFOOT
base_effect: Roots reach up from the ground to ensnare a victim of up to Size 4 (Medium). On Success, the victim gains the Held Debuff, and the Rank of this Spell is used in the Opposed Difficulty to escape instead of the default Str.

upgrades.5: Can target victims up to size Large (5). Duration is 3 rounds.
upgrades.10: Can target victims up to size Huge (6). Duration is 4 rounds.
upgrades.15: Can target victims up to size Colossal (7). The victim also gains the Poisoned Debuff.

name: SECOND CHANCE
base_effect: You raise a Mob with a level lower than your own from the dead. The Mob temporarily becomes your Undead Minion with half of its original Health Bar slots; you spend one Action to command it, then it acts independently with 1 Move Action and 1 other Action until given new instructions.

upgrades.5: The Mob can be up to 5 levels higher than you, and the duration is 5 minutes.
upgrades.10: The Mob can be up to 10 levels higher than the caster, with a duration of 15 minutes.
upgrades.15: The Mob can be up to 15 levels higher than the caster, with a duration of 45 minutes.

name: SHIELD
base_effect: You are surrounded by a translucent force field that moves with you and reduces non-magic damage you take. The Shield has 2 Health Bar slots, each with your Con Mod; damage reduces these slots first, the spell ends early if all slots are lost, and you can't heal a Shield.

upgrades.5: The Shield has 5 Health Bar slots.
upgrades.10: The Shield has 10 Health Bar slots.
upgrades.15: The Shield has 15 Health Bar slots.

name: SHOCK TREATMENT
base_effect: Like a deranged emperor, bolts of electricity shoot out from your fingers.

upgrades.5: +1d2 base damage, and you may choose to afflict the target with the Stunned Debuff instead of dealing damage.
upgrades.10: +1d2 base damage, and add 1 Rank damage die (Electric) at the end of the round.
upgrades.15: +1d2 base damage, and if you make this attack at melee range, you deal x5 the total damage.

name: SOLSPLASH
base_effect: Beams of concentrated 'sunlight' fall upon the victim and those around them.

upgrades.5: +1d8 base damage, +5ft Splash.
upgrades.10: +1d8 base damage and +10ft Splash. Each affected entity who loses at least 3 Health Bar slots this way gains the Burned Debuff.
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage and +15ft Splash.

name: SOUL COLLECTOR
base_effect: With a twist of your hand, you siphon the spirit from your target.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage, and if this Spell deals the killing blow to a foe of at least half your level, it deals +1 bonus damage until you complete a long rest. This damage bonus is cumulative up to the Spell's Rank.
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage, and the bonus continues for one week.
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage, and the bonus continues for as long as you remain on your current floor.

name: THUNDERLASH
base_effect: You unleash a whip-like emanation of pure sound which thunders through the air.

upgrades.5: +1d10 base damage.
upgrades.10: +1d10 base damage, and this attack deals Armor-Piercing damage (ignores DR).
upgrades.15: +1d10 base damage, and you can change the range to a 15ft Cone attack.

name: TORCH
base_effect: You create a magical orb of light that follows slightly above and behind you, providing bright light for a 20ft radius and dim light for a 20ft radius past that, until you enter a saferoom or descend to a new floor.

upgrades.5: You can move the orb up to 20 feet away from you.
upgrades.10: You can move the orb up to 60 feet away from you and can double the radius of the brightness with a thought.
upgrades.15: You can move the orb up to 100 feet away from you and attach it to a surface as an Action.

name: TRIPPER
base_effect: With a snap of your fingers, every movement, heat, and weight-triggered trap in the area 'goes off.' It does not detonate traps with very specific triggers, and must be imbued onto something you are wearing.

upgrades.5: +Intelligence Burst radius.
upgrades.10: +Intelligence Burst radius.
upgrades.15: +Intelligence Burst radius, and all damage taken is considered Splash (half damage).

name: TURN UNDEAD
base_effect: Make a single Cha-Opposed Spell Check vs. the Undead Mobs in the affected area. On Success, the Undead Mob runs away for the duration of the Spell; it does not work against Bosses.

upgrades.5: +5ft Cone. Duration is 5 rounds.
upgrades.10: +5ft Cone. Duration is 10 rounds.
upgrades.15: +5ft Cone. Duration is 15 rounds. On an Amazing Success or better, the Undead Mob is destroyed.

name: TWINKLE TOES
base_effect: Target a pet or minion within range. It has Move x2 for a number of seconds equal to your Intelligence.

upgrades.5: The pet or minion has Move x3 for the duration.
upgrades.10: The pet or minion has Move x4 for the duration.
upgrades.15: The pet or minion has Move x5 for the duration.

name: UNNECESSARY FORCE
base_effect: A shockwave akin to that of an A-bomb crashes over your target.

upgrades.5: +1d12 base damage.
upgrades.10: +1d12 base damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet.
upgrades.15: +1d12 base damage, and the target is pushed 15 feet.

name: VINE PORN
base_effect: Magical vines with pulsating veins shoot up from the ground or sprout from the target's own body to rip and tear and smack them around a bit.

upgrades.5: +1d4 base damage.
upgrades.10: +1d4 base damage, and this Attack deals Armor-Piercing damage (ignores DR).
upgrades.15: +1d4 base damage. On a Critical Hit, the target takes x4 damage.

name: WALL OF FIRE
base_effect: Creates a 30ft-long x 7ft-high x 2ft-thick wall of fire. Victims passing through it take damage and gain the Burned Debuff.
base_damage: 1d2 Fire for every 1ft of wall the victim passes through

upgrades.5: +1d2 base damage. The wall can be turned into a ring of fire. Duration is 5 rounds.
upgrades.10: +1d2 base damage. Creates a 50ft-long x 10ft-high x 3ft-thick wall. Duration is 10 rounds.
upgrades.15: +1d2 base damage. Creates a 100ft-long x 20ft-high x 5ft-thick wall. Duration is 15 rounds.

name: WATER BREATHING
base_effect: The target can breathe underwater without issue, for a number of seconds equal to the caster's Intelligence x3.

upgrades.5: You may now cast this upon others at a range of 5 feet.
upgrades.10: The targets roll Swimming Skill Checks with Advantage.
upgrades.15: You can target any or all individuals within a 15ft Burst radius.

name: WEB
base_effect: A cone of sticky webbing shoots from your fingers. Make a single Spell Attack Skill Check vs. each friend and foe's Evade (if any); on Success, that entity gains the Held Debuff, with the Rank of this spell used in the Opposed Difficulty to escape instead of Str.

upgrades.5: +5ft Cone. Duration is 5 rounds.
upgrades.10: +5ft Cone. Duration is 10 rounds.
upgrades.15: +5ft Cone. Duration is 15 rounds.

name: WILBUR'S SLOW-BUILD FIREBLAST
base_effect: This Spell can be cast and held as a swirling ring of fire around your ring finger until you unleash it; only one ring may be held at a time. The next time you perform an Attack Action, it must be this Spell (at no additional Mana cost). If anyone touches the ring with intent to diffuse it (you may oppose that Action), the Attack hits them for half damage and the appendage they touched you with smolders, useless for a number of rounds equal to the damage inflicted.

upgrades.5: +1d8 base damage. For each full day you hold the spell, +1d8 Fire damage.
upgrades.10: +1d8 base damage and +5ft Splash.
upgrades.15: +1d8 base damage and +5ft Splash.

name: WISP ARMOR
base_effect: You conjure a protective barrier that reduces all magic damage (typically Spells) down to its Rank 1 base damage (1 die + Stat Mod) without any Upgrades or other bonuses. This Spell also makes you immune to Mind Control.

upgrades.5: The duration is 10 minutes.
upgrades.10: The duration is 15 minutes.
upgrades.15: The duration is 20 minutes.
